commons_description: The DATARMOR Center hosts Ifremer's high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and scientific data storage infrastructures. Located in Brest harbor, the Datarmor Center is Ifremer's Tier 2 high-performance computing and artificial intelligence center. Ideally located at the intersection of data and advanced computing, it boasts one of the largest supercomputers dedicated to ocean research. Currently undergoing renewal, the computing and storage infrastructure is in line with the major equipment made available to Ifremer's scientific community and its academic and industrial partners.
